description: The Formlabs Form 4 is a masked stereolithography (MSLA) resin 3D printer. In a makerspace, students use it to print detailed, smooth-surfaced prototypes, fitted assemblies, models and functional parts from liquid photopolymer resin, in a build volume of 20.0 × 12.5 × 21.0 cm. After printing, parts are washed to remove uncured resin and then UV-cured to finish them.

specs.label: XY resolution
specs.value: 50 µm pixel size with pre-tuned anti-aliasing

specs.label: Light source
specs.value: 60 LEDs, 405 nm wavelength, 16 mW/cm² at the cure plane

specs.label: Print speed
specs.value: Up to 100 mm/hr maximum; 45 mm/hr average for general-purpose resins

specs.label: Resin heating
specs.value: Auto-heats resin to 25–45 °C (77–113 °F), depending on material

useRestrictions: Only for students trained on the Form 4 and its resin handling, washing and curing workflow, and only with resins approved by lab staff.
